w: During his blessings in the evening assembly at Akshar Mandir, Swamishri emphasized the importance of overcoming tension."... When people suffer from tension they gamble, drink liquor and start smoking. But does this dissolve tension? When one doesn’t have money one gets tension. When one is out of a job one suffers from tension. So instead of saving money, doesn’t one’s tension increase by squandering it on drinking? During such a crises one should introspect and pray to God. One should not despair but be patient and have faith
Swamishri performed the pratishtha rituals of murtis of Shri Hanumanji and Shri Ganapatiji to be installed in the hari mandir in Rangpar and Bhoyka.

The evening assembly was held to felicitate BAPS sadhus, volunteers, craftsmen and all those who had helped in the creation of Swaminarayan Akshardham. Their tremendous service and sacrifice were recognized and appreciated as each principal member involved in the project came on stage to receive a memento and the blessings of Swamishri. On behalf of BAPS Mahant Swami and Dr Swami garlanded Swamishri who was the inspirer and creator of the entire complex. Ishwarcharan Swami, the coordinator of the entire project, also garlanded Swamishri and received his blessings. In his blessings Swamishri said, “Akshardham complex has been accomplished through the wish of Bhagwan Swaminarayan and Yogiji Maharaj. All credit goes to Maharaj, Swami, Bhagatji Maharaj, Shastriji Maharaj and Yogiji Maharaj. Everyone involved in the project has not seen day or night while serving. Regardless of discomfort you have all performed your services with glory and feelings. Mementos have been received by all those who have served, but even if countless more were to be given to you it would still be inadequate. The sadhus who have served will be blessed with peace in their hearts. Yogiji Maharaj’s formula was samp, suhrudbhav and ekta. When any work is done with these sentiments then the impossible can become possible. Akshardham has been accomplished through the unity and determination of sadhus and devotees. Everyone, residing in India and abroad, had performed austerities, pilgrimages and other spiritual endeavors for the early completion of Akshardham. All wellwishers who have contributed be blessed with the attainment of Akshardham.”

Guests: H.H. Sadguru Bodinath Veylan Swami, Head of Himalayan Academy, Hawaii, opined, “An excellent combination of traditional Indian architecture and modern technology in exhibits and film to convey the greatness and values of national and regional lines.”

The evening assembly was dedicated as Volunteer Day. Viveksagar Swami addressed the volunteers. Thereafter a volunteer gave details of the Annakut festival preparations. He said that the planning started six months in advance. The 1,100 volunteers served from 6.00 am till 12.00 midnight on Diwali day and from 5.00 am till 12.00 midnight on New Year’s Day. Finally, appreciating the volunteers’ services Swamishri said, “All of you have heartily served with body, mind and wealth for the Annakut festival. Maharaj, Shastriji Maharaj and Yogiji Maharaj will be very happy upon you all. The entire festival was celebrated with proper planning. One felt peaceful on seeing the annakut in the assembly hall. The replica of Bochasan mandir here is par-excellence. Though it is made of polystyrene, from far it looks like it is made of marble. Your services are highly congratulatory and they reflect your profound bhakti. Maharaj will be immensely happy. Shastriji Maharaj and Yogiji Maharaj will be tremendously happy upon you all. Without mahima it is not possible to offer such bhakti. You have done all this with mahima. One must have a single firm thought in one’s heart while doing seva – to please God. The seva should not be done for praise, fame or personal glory. You were able to do all this because you served as humble servants of servants.”
ph: Swamishri waves a BAPS flag for the Sanstha's Centenary Celebration

st.t: Pramukh Swami Maharaj – Volunteers Appreciation Day – Friday 3 November 2006 London
w: Volunteers Appreciation Day was held in the presence of Pramukh Swami Maharaj on Friday 3 November 2006. The evening sabha began with Viveksagar Swami talking on the qualities of an ideal volunteer. After a video presentation and a short report on the dedication of the volunteers for this year’s Diwali and Annakut celebrations, various garlands were offered to Swamishri on behalf of all the BAPS volunteers in the UK and across Europe. Swamishri spoke on the sincere dedication, enthusiasm and commitment of the volunteers throughout the year and especially during the recent Annakut festival. Swamishri was very pleased with the care and concern catering for all the visitors’ needs during the festival. He gave his heartiest blessings to all the volunteers.

After the mangala arti in the morning, the pratishtha rituals of the Guru Parampara murtis commenced at the hands of senior sadhus: Bhagatji Maharaj – Pujya Tyagvallabh Swami, Shastriji Maharaj – Pujya Mahant Swami, Yogiji Maharaj – Pujya Ishwarcharan Swami, Pramukh Swami Maharaj – Pujya Viveksagar Swami, Hanumanji – Pujya Siddheshwar Swami and Ganapatiji – Pujya Ghanshyamcharan Swami. Devotees who had offered their services for the occasion were seated in the mandir pradakshina.
Swamishri performed pujan and arti of the murtis of Bhagatji Maharaj, Shastriji Maharaj, Yogiji Maharaj, Hanumanji and Ganapatiji.

During the meal, Divyasankalp Swami, Yatiraj Swami and Vivekshil Swami gave discourses on the yoga of the manifest Aksharbrahma described in the Gita. Finally Vivekshil Swami said, "Through you, we have been connected with God in person."
Pramukh Swami Maharaj said, "That we became sadhus at Yogiji Maharaj's command is the connection. As much connection as one has with him, that much is the direct connection."

During the meal, Divyasankalp Swami, Yatiraj Swami and Viveksheel Swami spoke about the yoga of the manifest Aksharbrahman described in the Gita. At the end Viveksheel Swami said, “Through you we have found the yoga of God himself.”
Swamishri said, “We became sadhus by Yogiji Maharaj’s command. That is the yoga. The more we stay close to him, the more we have the yoga of God himself.”

ds.p: In the car from Gandhinagar to Bochasan
w: When Mahant Swami Maharaj set off for Bochasan seated in the car, Hariprakashdas Swami recited from memory Vachanamrut Antya 39. Then Hariprakashdas Swami asked Swamishri, "Would you like to give an explanation?"
Swamishri spoke a little and then, remembering his guru, said:

"Whatever honour is given belongs only to Swamibapa. He is the master... then we are free, nothing is on our head. Everything is his and goes back to him. Just as a munimji (accountant) may write a salary of ten million rupees, but his own salary is only four hundred rupees." (Swamishri was comparing his guru, Pramukh Swami Maharaj, to the seth (master) and himself to the munimji.)

He went on, "All this is like a millionaire who has many, many things, but he does not go around showing them. And if someone is a world champion and we say, 'This is the world champion,' he does not get up and start running. In the same way all power belongs to God. Whenever needed we take from it and put it back. Nothing is ours, not even a stalk. Everything belongs to God."
"All power belongs to God. Whenever needed we take from it and put it back." Which person of this world could say such a sentence?
